module_summary: GMII PHY interface: source-synchronous SDR input/output blocks register RX and TX GMII signals between MAC and PHY, with a mii_select clock mux and per-domain reset synchronizers.

anchors.name: phy_gmii_rxd
anchors.why: Receive data from PHY captured by SDR input block.

anchors.name: phy_gmii_rx_dv
anchors.why: PHY receive data valid captured with rxd.

anchors.name: phy_gmii_rx_er
anchors.why: PHY receive error captured with rxd.

anchors.name: phy_gmii_rx_clk
anchors.why: Forwarded PHY receive clock driving SDR input capture.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rx_dv
anchors.why: Registered receive data valid to MAC.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_txd
anchors.why: Transmit data from MAC into SDR output block.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_tx_en
anchors.why: MAC transmit enable retimed to PHY.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_tx_er
anchors.why: MAC transmit error retimed to PHY.

anchors.name: phy_gmii_tx_clk
anchors.why: Forwarded transmit clock generated by SDR output ODDR.

anchors.name: mii_select
anchors.why: Selects MII PHY tx clock or system clk for MAC tx clock.

anchors.name: phy_mii_tx_clk
anchors.why: PHY-supplied MII transmit clock, mux input for tx clock.

anchors.name: tx_rst_reg
anchors.why: Shift-register reset synchronizer for MAC tx clock domain.

anchors.name: rx_rst_reg
anchors.why: Shift-register reset synchronizer for MAC rx clock domain.

groups.name: rx_path
groups.description: SDR input capture of PHY GMII receive signals to MAC.

groups.name: tx_path
groups.description: SDR output retiming of MAC transmit signals with forwarded clock.

groups.name: tx_clock_select
groups.description: Clock mux choosing GMII or MII transmit clock.

groups.name: reset_sync
groups.description: Per-domain reset synchronizers for MAC rx/tx resets.
